args.situation_assessment: Top-level goal is to gather at least one log into inventory, but current nearby evidence shows only grass, dirt, stone, and no visible logs or crafting resources. A fresh observe is the safest bounded step to confirm whether any reachable log blocks are loaded nearby before choosing movement or a more specific gather action.
args.why_this_tool: Observe is the only ready direct primitive that can refresh live nearby block evidence and potentially reveal reachable logs or a clearer blocker without guessing a target position or block name.
success_evidence: Updated nearby block and inventory evidence
Any visible log block or tree-related block appears in the refreshed scan
A confirmed blocker if no reachable logs are present
args.failure_handling: If the observe returns no new log evidence, remember that logs are not currently evidenced nearby and pivot to movement or another scouting action rather than repeating the same scan blindly.
